title: Manna in the Wilderness Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Manna in the Wilderness Bible Crossword
description: Solve a manna Bible crossword: bread from heaven, the quails, the omer, and the day that gathered double. KJV clues from Exodus 16, free on iOS.
prose: A month out of Egypt the people are hungry and say so, loudly. In the evening quails cover the camp; in the morning there is a small round thing on the ground, and nobody knows what it is — which is where the name comes from. Manna in the Wilderness makes a grid of Exodus 16.

The rules attached to it are the interesting part: an omer for every man, none kept till morning except before the sabbath, and twice as much gathered on the sixth day. The closing verse is the morning it first appears.

clues.text: Small round thing, as hoar frost on the ground
They came up and covered the camp at even
Day on which they gathered twice as much

verseText: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
